## What's Changed

- Added a unified, authenticated Tater music catalog endpoint for Music Core.
- Music scans now read embedded title, artist, album artist, album, genre, year,
  track number, and duration tags with folder and filename fallbacks.
- Added normalized artist, album, and genre facets so voice requests such as
  “play reggae music” can be resolved deterministically.
- Added stable catalog fingerprints, pagination, filters, and authenticated
  local stream URLs for paired music players.
- Existing Tater Tube Player music-library endpoints remain compatible.

## Upgrade

Pull the latest container and restart:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/tatertotterson/tater-tube-server:latest
docker restart tater-tube-server
```

No database migration is required. Music metadata is cached as the library is
scanned and refreshes automatically when a file's size or modification time
changes.
